old_title: Transfer news LIVE: Arsenal make Barcola decision, huge Man Utd boost
new_title: Transfer news LIVE: Alvarez to Arsenal boost, Barcola set for Liverpool medical
old_text:
Arsenal are hoping to secure the signing of Julian Alvarez to cap off a productive summer of incomings and boost their forward line as they look to defend their Premier League title. Alvarez is said to be open to the move having initially favoured a switch to Barcelona.
Liverpool's pursuit of PSG's Bradley Barcola was given a boost when he was left out of the squad for their game against Rennes with PSG insiders now expecting the winger to leave the clubs this summer. The Reds have also seen two bids for Brighton's Yankuba Minteh turned down.
Elsewhere, Manchester City have agreed a €100m deal with Lille to buy midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi and have sold Savinho to Tottenham in a deal worht £85m. They are also interested in Liverpool's Cody Gakpo. Across the city, Manchester United target Alejandro Balde reportedly wants to leave Barcelona with the Premier League club exploring a loan move for the left-back.
Ollie Watkins and Emi Martinez were also absent from Aston Villa's matchday squad amid rumours that both players could be preparing for imminent exits with Watkins' in particular looking very close to a move to Saudi Arabian side Al-Hilal.
Follow all of the latest news, rumours and done deals below
Why Carlos Baleba fixes Man United's biggest problem
After Man United's 2-0 loss away at Hull City, it became even more apparent that Michael Carrick has a big problem to fix in his midfield. Enter Carlos Baleba, who has joined United from Brighton.
But what is Baleba good at? And will he actually fix Man United's problems in the midfield? Adam Clery explores what the Cameroonian could bring to Old Trafford, and how his skill set can help Carrick's side this season.
Newcastle agree £52m deal for Manchester City midfielder as Bruno Guimaraes replacement
Newcastle have agreed a £52m deal with Manchester City for Nico Gonzalez and the midfielder is set to become their biggest summer signing.
The 2025 Carabao Cup winners will pay an initial £48m for the Spaniard with a potential £4m in add-ons.
It could give City a small profit after signing Gonzalez from Porto in January 2025 for £49m.
Gonzalez, while only 24, will become the oldest player Newcastle have signed this summer after they decided they need to add more experience following the departures of captain Bruno Guimaraes and Sandro Tonali from the midfield.
Tottenham complete £85m signing of Man City winger Savinho
Savinho has completed his £85m move from Tottenham to Manchester City as Spurs have taken their spending this summer past £300m.
The Brazilian becomes City's record sale - replacing Julian Alvarez, who moved to Atletico Madrid for £82m two years ago - and one of the three most expensive players in Tottenham's history, along with his new teammates Sandro Tonali and Mateus Fernandes.
Spurs will pay an initial £75m, with a further £5m of add-ons guaranteed and the potential for £5m more on top of that.
Liverpool's alarming weakness is clear and signing a new winger won't solve it
What could Liverpool do in the remaining few days of the transfer window? The Reds drew 2-2 at Newcastle on Sunday, but Andoni Iraola is struggling for midfield balance, with Ryan Gravenberch's role uncertain after a mixed performance at St James' Park, writes Richard Jolly:
Man United seal Carlos Baleba deal to complete £148m midfield overhaul
Carlos Baleba has joined Manchester United as Michael Carrick has completed a hat-trick of midfield buys this season.
The Cameroon international, who has signed a five-year deal at Old Trafford, has joined from Brighton for an initial £65m.
United could pay an extra £5m in add-ons for the 22-year-old, who believes he can reach a new level under Carrick, a former midfielder.
Will Julian Alvarez sign for Arsenal? Here's what we know as transfer deadline looms
Will Julian Alvarez join Arsenal? It could be the transfer saga that defines the final week of the window. Alan Smith takes a look at everything we know:
Why Ollie Watkins' move to Saudi Arabia will tarnish his Aston Villa legacy
The England striker Ollie Watkins seems dead set on leaving Villa in the lurch to join Al Hilal - which, Richard Jolly writes, is a great shame for a club and player who were very good for one another:
Chelsea could bid again for Alex Scott
Chelsea are preparing to go back to Bournemouth for Alex Scott, as Enzo Fernandez moves closer to a move to Manchester City.
Bournemouth have so far shut down any interest, but there's a belief a bid of £80m-plus (prob closer to £90m) might bring reconsideration.
Nottingham Forest agree £50m deal for Liam Delap
Nottingham Forest have agreed a club record deal of £50m to sign Chelsea striker Liam Delap.
The former Ipswich man has been displaced in the No 9 shirt at Stamford Bridge by Joao Pedro and the Chelsea hierarchy were open to letting him leave after a disappointing first campaign at the club.
Chelsea will make £20m profit on a striker they signed for £30m, and who scored just two goals in 41 appearances.
The 23-year-old is expected to complete a medical on Wednesday.
Man Utd receive Balde boost
Spanish publication Marca are reporting that Alejandro Balde has decided that he wants to leave Barcelona in a huge boost to Manchester United's hopes of signing him.
The report says that Joao Cancelo's arrival and the fact that Balde was left out of Barca's matchday squad for the game against Elche has changed Balde's mind about remaining at the club and fighting for his place.
United are the frontrunners for his signature but they are said to want a loan deal instead of a permanent transfer as previously reported.
new_text:
Julian Alvarez has stayed away from Atletico Madrid training for a second day in a row after the Arsenal transfer target was told that there was "zero per cent chance" of getting his dream move to Barcelona this summer.
The 26-year-old forward is Arsenal's top target and continue to monitor the situation ahead of potentially making a late move, with Atletico setting a deadline of Friday for the Argentina international's future to be resolved.
Liverpool have agreed a £100m fee, with £20m in add-ons, with Paris Saint-Germain to sign Bradley Barcola after the French club lowered their demands for the forward and still want to sign Ismaila Sarr from Crystal Palace. But Andoni Iraola refused to guarantee that Cody Gakpo will stay at Liverpool, with the Dutchman has attracted interest from Tottenham and Manchester City.
Elsewhere, Manchester City could yet reignite a move for Chelsea's Enzo Fernandez, making him potentially the biggest transfer of the summer. Chelsea are also in talks to sign Aston Villa goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez and could turn back to Bournemouth's Alex Scott if they sell Fernandez.
Follow all of the latest news, rumours and done deals below:
Marseille keen on Arsenal goalkeeper
Illan Meslier could be heading for the exit at Arsenal just weeks after signing for the Gunners.
The third-choice goalkeeper, behind David Raya and Kepa Arrizabalaga, joined after the expiry of his contract at Leeds United.
But now Foot Mercato reports Marseille could target the shot-stopper after losing Geronimo Rulli this summer.
Meslier could displace Jeffrey De Lange and gain valuable first-team football.
Fiorentina pushing to sign Man United forward Zirkzee ahead of Juventus
Manchester United forward Joshua Zirkzee looks to be heading back to Serie A, reports Sky Sport Italia's Gianluca Di Marzio.
Zirkzee could be a replacement for Moise Kean, who is set to join Como, with Fiorentina eyeing up Zirkzee and thought to have tabled a season-long loan for €5m (£4.3m) with an option to buy.
Juventus are also thought to be interested, with Zirkzee falling down the pecking order behind Benjamin Sesko and Bryan Mbeumo as centre forward options under Michael Carrick.
Napoli enquire about Woltemade
Napoli have enquired about signing Nick Woltemade from Newcastle United, with a loan mooted, according to transfer guru Fabrizio Romano. It is up to Newcastle whether they sanction the move...
Manchester City consider Everton winger as replacement for departed duo
Manchester City are contemplating a move for Iliman Ndiaye to add to their forward options - with Jack Grealish perhaps going the other way to Everton.
Liverpool continue pursuit of Ismaila Sarr from Crystal Palace with Cody Gakpo's future in doubt
Liverpool are still pursuing Ismaila Sarr, despite seeing an initial offer of around £50m rejected by Crystal Palace.
Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola wants to bring in three more players before the end of the transfer window, including two who can operate in wide positions. One of those will be France winger Bradley Barcola, after PSG accepted an offer of £100m plus £20m in potential add-ons for the 23-year-old.
And while Liverpool have moved on from Yankuba Minteh following Brighton's resistance, The Independent understands the club are not yet discouraged from a deal to bring in Sarr.
Arsenal receive Julian Alvarez boost as forward misses training
Arsenal target Julian Alvarez missed Atletico Madrid training for the second day in a row after he was told there is a "zero per cent chance" that he gets to join Barcelona this summer.
The 26-year-old forward has made it clear that he would like to join Barcelona, while Arsenal continue to monitor the situation and may move to make a late deal for the Argentina international. He was booed during a substitute appearance in Atletico's draw with Villarreal on Sunday night and missed a midweek match due to "illness".
"The members of Atlético de Madrid's Board of Directors have unanimously expressed their absolute support for the club's decision to not negotiate the transfer of Julián Alvarez to FC Barcelona," a statement said on Thursday.
Chelsea set to sign £40m Italian teenager Ahanor
Fabrizio Romano has given Chelsea's pursuit of Atalanta prospect Honest Ahanor the 'Here We Go' treatment, ahead of his imminent £40m transfer.
It's a huge fee for an 18-year-old, but the Ahanor has already made 41 appearances for the Italian club and has earned two international caps for the senior Italy team.
The left-footed defender can player centre-back or left-back and is widely considered one of the best young talents in Europe. He is likely to be either loaned back to Atalanta or another club to gain more experience.
Ward-Prowse set for Saints homecoming
James Ward-Prowse is set to return to Southampton after three years away from his boyhood club.
City still in business before deadline day
Manchester City are not done in the transfer market yet, and it sounds like they will be chasing experience in the final days of the window.
"We need to see if we can add one or two more captains," Enzo Maresca said today.
Enzo Fernandez remains a top target.
